svg.title: Keep the source and your conclusion separate
svg.desc: Give every quotation or paraphrase a source and a precise locator. Put your interpretation in a separate, clearly labeled field, preserve the source’s limits, and record what still needs checking. When your conclusion changes, retain a brief correction trail so you can see which source supported which version.

text.font-family: Pretendard, SUIT, Noto Sans KR, Apple SD Gothic Neo, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif
